scope: Original chapter vocabulary, optional gist/changed-detail retelling, and bounded A2 conversation choices for the maintained daily portal.
sourceGrounding: Each chapter bank and A2 scene reuses the existing verified mission source IDs and physical-page references for topic grounding. Vocabulary, examples, scenes and transfer outcomes are original portal writing; no claim is made that this is the publisher’s word list or audio transcript.
assessmentLimits: Gist answers are explicitly witnessed by the unchanged original portal dialogue.
Retelling changes details and is self-assessed with two bilingual criteria.
Conversation choices assess a bounded authored reply, not unrestricted Italian.
Device speech is optional synthetic listening support, not a publisher recording or pronunciation assessment.
The final subjunctive chapter introduces only the specified forms and opinion frames; it does not certify A2 mastery.
progress: All 18 original banks, 144 original word IDs, 36 original enrichments and 8 original scenes are unchanged. Only the 20 previously added book enrichments change bank and gain optional skills. Session bank pinning and legacy fallbacks are integrated separately by the application owner.

validation.browserStatus: Awaiting integrated EN/IT student journeys; no browser test is claimed by this content review.

independentLanguageReview.method: Read each new Italian/English term and contextual example; compare every new gist against its existing four-line portal scene; check retelling models against requested changed details; inspect conversation prompts, distractors, hints and explanations.
independentLanguageReview.result: No blocking Italian grammar/agreement error, unsupported gist fact or second correct conversation choice was found within the task’s stated tense, register and grammatical-form constraints. Retelling models satisfy their changed-detail prompts.

refinementsVerified.change: The English gloss for prima now includes first, matching its contextual example.
The Italian instruction now says to use noi for the group actions, removing the ambiguous per noi wording.
Applicable noun prompts explicitly exclude articles and possessives, clarifying the accepted short-answer form.

limits: This bounded linguistic review covers original portal writing, not all publisher exercises or every source page.
A2 subjunctive work remains an introduction to specified frames, not evidence of general subjunctive mastery or CEFR certification.
This review does not claim integrated browser acceptance or measured learning outcomes.
